eir.1001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.1001.t
	desc = eir.1001.desc
	theme = legend
	cooldown = { years = 10 }

	trigger = {
		eir_is_gael_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		employs_court_position = eir_ollamh_court_position
		NOT = { has_character_flag = eir_flavor_cd }
	}

	immediate = {
		court_position:eir_ollamh_court_position ?= { save_scope_as = eir_holder }
		add_character_flag = { flag = eir_flavor_cd years = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.1001.a
		stress_impact = {
			generous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			greedy = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
		add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_royal_ollamh_modifier years = 6 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = generous
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.1001.b
		stress_impact = {
			arrogant = minor_stress_impact_loss
			humble = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = medium_gold_value
		add_prestige = major_prestige_gain
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_bardic_circuit_modifier years = 8 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = arrogant
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.1001.c
		stress_impact = {
			shrewd = minor_stress_impact_loss
			trusting = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		add_stress = minor_stress_gain
		ai_chance = { base = 15 }
	}
}
